citation.title: Learning topology optimization process via convolutional long-short-term memory autoencoder-decoder
citation.authors: Qiaochu Ma, Edward C. DeMeter, Saurabh Basu
citation.venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering
citation.version_coded: open-access version of record, publisher HTML

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The learned sequence model reduces per-query computation by 99.97% relative to SIMP on 40 x 40 meshes, while its reported compliance error is 5.13% after excluding two disconnected outputs.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Section 4.1 prints 3.711 s for SIMP and 0.001 s for the model; 3.711/0.001 = 3711.
claim.alternatives: Abstract qualitatively claims significant cost reduction; Table 2 reports 99.97%-99.99% saved across mesh sizes; Table 3 compares inference/SIMP ratios with other ML models.

baseline.hardware_classical: not stated separately; Section 4 says experiments on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3090 GPU
baseline.problem_size: 40 x 40 elements for Table 1; 80 x 40 and 80 x 80 also tested (Section 4, Table 2)
baseline.classical_iterations: fixed 100 iterations, said to converge in samples (Section 3.2)
baseline.classical_time: 3.711 s average for 40 x 40 test cases (Section 4.1)
baseline.ml_time: 0.001 s average for 40 x 40 test cases; initial three SIMP encoder steps are required but their time is not itemized (Sections 3.4, 4.1)
baseline.training_time: Figure 11 plots training times by mesh and hidden dimension; exact values not stated in text (Section 4.3)
baseline.data_generation_cost: 5,000 training, 100 validation and 100 test SIMP samples, each run for 100 iterations; wall-clock generation cost not stated (Sections 3.2, 4)
baseline.quality_metric: pixel value error and compliance error versus SIMP (Section 4.1, Table 1)
baseline.quality_gap: 4.92% average final pixel error; 5.13% average compliance error after excluding two disconnected cases (Section 4.1, Table 1)

R1.evidence: Section 4.1, Table 1: 3.711 s SIMP is compared with 0.001 s model inference despite 5.13% compliance error; two disconnected cases are omitted from this quality average, and three required SIMP input steps are not separately timed.

R2.evidence: Sections 3.2 and 4: classical baseline is Topy and ML experiments use a GTX 3090; separate classical hardware and its sparse solver are not specified, so hardware comparability is unresolved.

R3.evidence: Sections 3.2 and 4.1: 5,200 SIMP samples are generated and inference-only savings are claimed, but generation/training costs and break-even uses are not quantified.

R4.evidence: Section 4.1: returned designs are evaluated by compliance and two disconnected cases among 100 tests are identified, but their compliance is omitted from the average and volume-constraint violations are not reported.

notes: Publisher PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403; the publisher's open-access HTML held the complete article. Two disconnected cases are explicitly acknowledged but excluded from the mean compliance error.
